properties.name: Left-field foul pole
properties.why: Left-field foul pole, at the foot of the Green Monster on the third-base line. The line is the white one drawn from home plate to the wall in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 (about 18 m west of the field's centre, where it meets the wall's face). Height is the wall's 11.33 m plus the 30 ft (9.1 m) that a foul pole stands above a fence: a standard dimension for this kind of thing, not a measurement. Direction 90 is toward fair territory, where the pole's mesh screen is.

properties.name: Right-field foul pole
properties.why: Right-field foul pole at the end of the first-base line. Its foot shows as a yellow speck at the line's end where it meets the stands in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, 93 m (306 ft) from home plate. Height is a 3 m fence plus the 30 ft (9.1 m) that a foul pole stands above a fence: a standard dimension for this kind of thing, not a measurement. Direction 0 is toward fair territory (north), where the mesh screen is.
